description: Allocated cost per data stream for one deployment, split into indexing, query and storage components and a blended total, using the same weighted formula as the Chargeback dashboards. max_daily_storage_snapshot_bytes is the MAX of per-day summed storage snapshots in the window (not point-in-time bytes stored). This is the main tool for answering 'which data streams cost the most' and for finding candidates to shorten retention on or move to a cheaper tier.

configuration.query:
FROM chargeback_lookup.billing_realized_pool
| WHERE @timestamp IS NOT NULL AND data_tier_capacity_ecu IS NOT NULL
| EVAL billing_ts = @timestamp, ck = composite_key::keyword, billing_deployment_id = deployment_id, bill_is_onprem = COALESCE(is_onprem, false)
| WHERE DATE_DIFF("day", billing_ts, NOW()) <= ?days AND billing_deployment_id == ?deployment_id
| DROP composite_key
| LOOKUP JOIN cluster_capacity_utilization_lookup ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| EVAL ts = billing_ts, cloud_cfg_key = "chargeback_config"
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON cloud_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL cloud_rate = conf_chargeable_unit_rate, cloud_unit = conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, c_idx_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_indexing_weight), c_qry_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_query_weight), c_sto_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_storage_weight), c_mem_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_memory_weight), c_disk_w = TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_storage_weight), c_util_floor = TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_floor)
| DROP cloud_cfg_key, config_join_key, conf_start_date, conf_end_date, conf_chargeable_unit_rate, conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit
| EVAL onprem_cfg_key = CASE(bill_is_onprem, "chargeback_config_onprem", null)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_conf_lookup ON onprem_cfg_key == config_join_key AND ts >= conf_start_date AND ts <= conf_end_date
| EVAL rate = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate, 0.00085), COALESCE(cloud_rate, 0.85)), currency_unit = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(conf_chargeable_unit_rate_unit, cloud_unit, "EUR"), COALESCE(cloud_unit, "EUR")), idx_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(TO_DOUBLE(conf_indexing_weight), c_idx_w, 20.0), COALESCE(c_idx_w, 20.0)), qry_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(TO_DOUBLE(conf_query_weight), c_qry_w, 20.0), COALESCE(c_qry_w, 20.0)), sto_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(TO_DOUBLE(conf_storage_weight), c_sto_w, 40.0), COALESCE(c_sto_w, 40.0)), mem_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_memory_weight), c_mem_w, 70.0), COALESCE(c_mem_w, 70.0)), disk_w = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_storage_weight), c_disk_w, 30.0), COALESCE(c_disk_w, 30.0)), util_floor = CASE(bill_is_onprem, COALESCE(TO_DOUBLE(conf_utilization_floor), c_util_floor, 0.10), COALESCE(c_util_floor, 0.10))
| EVAL heap_util = COALESCE(heap_used_pct_p95, 100.0) / 100.0, disk_util = COALESCE(disk_used_pct_p95, 100.0) / 100.0
| EVAL raw_utilization_score = CASE(mem_w + disk_w > 0.0, (mem_w * heap_util + disk_w * disk_util) / (mem_w + disk_w), 1.0)
| EVAL utilization_score = CASE(raw_utilization_score < util_floor, util_floor, raw_utilization_score)
| EVAL chargeable_pool = data_tier_capacity_ecu * COALESCE(utilization_score, 1.0)
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.cluster_deployment_contribution ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key, usage_source
| LOOKUP JOIN chargeback_lookup.cluster_datastream_contribution ON ck == composite_key
| DROP composite_key
| WHERE datastream IS NOT NULL
| EVAL indexing_ecu = COALESCE(CASE(deployment_sum_indexing_time > 0, TO_DOUBLE(datastream_sum_indexing_time) / deployment_sum_indexing_time * chargeable_pool), 0.0), querying_ecu = COALESCE(CASE(deployment_sum_query_time > 0, TO_DOUBLE(datastream_sum_query_time) / deployment_sum_query_time * chargeable_pool), 0.0), data_set_ecu = COALESCE(CASE(deployment_sum_data_set_store_size > 0, TO_DOUBLE(datastream_sum_data_set_store_size) / deployment_sum_data_set_store_size * chargeable_pool), 0.0), store_ecu = COALESCE(CASE(deployment_sum_store_size > 0, TO_DOUBLE(datastream_sum_store_size) / deployment_sum_store_size * chargeable_pool), 0.0)
| EVAL storage_ecu = CASE(deployment_sum_data_set_store_size > deployment_sum_store_size, data_set_ecu, store_ecu), eff_sto_w = CASE(COALESCE(deployment_sum_data_set_store_size, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(deployment_sum_store_size, 0) > 0, sto_w, 0.0), eff_qry_w = CASE(COALESCE(deployment_sum_query_time, 0) > 0, qry_w, 0.0), eff_idx_w = CASE(COALESCE(deployment_sum_indexing_time, 0) > 0, idx_w, 0.0)
| EVAL total_weight = eff_sto_w + eff_qry_w + eff_idx_w
| EVAL blended_ecu = CASE(total_weight > 0.0, (storage_ecu * eff_sto_w + querying_ecu * eff_qry_w + indexing_ecu * eff_idx_w) / total_weight, 0.0)
| EVAL idx_cost = indexing_ecu * rate, qry_cost = querying_ecu * rate, sto_cost = storage_ecu * rate, blended = blended_ecu * rate, ds_storage_bytes = CASE(deployment_sum_data_set_store_size > deployment_sum_store_size, datastream_sum_data_set_store_size, datastream_sum_store_size)
| STATS indexing_cost = SUM(idx_cost), query_cost = SUM(qry_cost), storage_cost = SUM(sto_cost), blended_cost = SUM(blended), currency = VALUES(currency_unit), max_daily_storage_snapshot_bytes = MAX(ds_storage_bytes)
    BY datastream, ds_type, ds_namespace
| WHERE blended_cost > 0
| SORT blended_cost DESC
| LIMIT 25

deployment_id.description: Deployment ID or Serverless project ID
